title: Solar capture of inelastic dark matter with delta ~ 300 keV and the neutrino-telescope constraints on the LZ-fitted couplings
question: Can the Sun capture 1 TeV inelastic DM with delta = 250-380 keV at the LZ-fitted Higgsino, dark-photon and Z' couplings, and does its annihilation exceed recalled IceCube/ANTARES solar-neutrino limits once those elastic SI/SD limits are translated to the inelastic capture rate?
headline_result: With the AGSS09ph profile (20 isotopes, v_esc 618-1373 km/s) the Sun captures the LZ-fitting 1 TeV Higgsino on core Fe/Ni at C = 4.4e23 (300 keV) to 1.5e23 s^-1 (366 keV) and annihilates it at Gamma_A = (0.5-22)e22 s^-1, 120-1900x the recalled IceCube W+W- limit and >= 15-770x above its weakest bracket even with stalled thermalisation, excluding the Higgsino at every delta; the dark photon and Z' are unconstrained/marginal for delta <~ 300-340 keV and excluded for delta >= 366 (dark photon), >= 360 (B-L Z'), >= 370 keV (U(1)_B), closing P021's 360-385 keV corner for all three models
key_numbers: delta_max centre (u=288): Fe 542, Ni 561, Ca/Ar 393, S 317, Si 278, O 161, He 41, H 10 keV; Fe threshold radius 0.44/0.34/0.26 R_sun at 250/300/366 keV; C(1 TeV, rho 0.4) at 250/300/350/366: Higgsino 8.1/4.4/2.0/1.5e23, DP 1.2e20/4.5e20/7.1e21/4.7e22, Z' 1.3e20/5.3e20/1.2e22/1.1e23 s^-1; C_inel/C_el 0.20-0.03; WimPyC validation +1.7-2.6%, P039 Fe+Ni +9-13%; two-step <0.6%; C_SD(H,1e-40)=C_SI(1e-43)=2.54e20; Gamma_lim WW 3.8e19 [1.3-13e19], A'A' 5e20, Z' B-L 9e19, U(1)_B 2.5e21; Higgsino Gamma_A/lim 120-1900 (366), 2600-5800 (300); A' decay length <= 30 m; stalled/thermal Gamma_A ratio 1.3-1000
model_or_mechanism: Gould capture per halo stream and solar shell with w^2 = u^2 + v_esc(r)^2, inelastic recoil window, capture condition E_R + delta >= m u^2/2, Helm FF; AGSS09ph profile via WimPyC; exothermic two-step correction; chi2 decay vs down-scatter; Griest-Seckel equilibrium vs orbit-confined (stalled) annihilation volume; elastic SD/SI conversion of recalled neutrino-telescope limits with channel factors (WW/ZZ, A'A'->4f tau content, Z'Z'->4f)
result_type: computed (capture, kinematics, conversions) / estimated (recalled limits, channel factors, thermalisation bracket)
confidence: medium - capture rates validated to a few %, but neutrino-telescope limits and channel factors are recalled (x3) and thermalisation is bracketed
software_and_packages: python 3.12.13; numpy 2.5.3; pandas 3.0.5; matplotlib 3.11.2; WimPyDD 2.0.4 incl. WimPyC (Sun profile, wimp_capture/wimp_capture_geom validation); common/lzcommon.py
local_inputs: PAPER_GUIDE; ledger; P039 details/CSVs/script; P011 sigma_p grid, epsilon, lifetimes, couplings; P054 lz_requirement, lifetimes; papers P007/P011/P021/P025/P026/P039/P054; WimPyC Sun densities.tab; lzcommon
recalled_knowledge: 14 (constants, AGSS09ph fidelity, rho_chi, Sommerfeld brackets, evaporation mass, IceCube/ANTARES/Super-K limits, channel factors, nu-nu weight, muon/pion stopping, thermalisation stall, corpus chi2 lifetimes; 4 uncertain)
